The '''''blue witch''''' was a device developed by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]]. The device masked its owner from all electronic surveillance, including visual surveillance and the most sophisticated security [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]].<ref name="Lockdown" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="Insider 146">{{InsiderCite|146|Blaster}}</ref> [[Vesto Slipher]], a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] field analyst of the Banking Clan, used the device to hide himself from the [[Cog Hive Seven]]'s surveillance.<ref name="Lockdown" />
